description: Searches Fiveable's question bank for one subject (the same bank as the assignment builder): multiple choice, stimulus sets, SAQs and FRQs, filtered by unit, topic, skill, format and stimulus, optionally hiding questions this teacher already published. For AP Calculus, courseVariant scopes AB to exclude BC-only units, topics and FRQs. Returns ids, short stems and alignment, never answers. Filters accept exact unit/topic/skill labels from the filter lists in the result. Cheap.

courseVariant.description: AP Calculus only: ap-calc-ab or ap-calc-bc, the course of the class or draft you are building for.

excludeAssigned.description: Hide questions this teacher already published.

query.description: Words to match in the question.

type.description: mcq = single question, question-set = stimulus set, saq, or frq (LEQ, DBQ and other FRQs).

name: search_question_bank

status.description: Operation status: completed, pending, partial, failed, unavailable, or a domain-specific outcome.

text.description: Readable tool result text for clients that consume structured output.

title: Search question bank
